title: Transimpedance amplifier
description: Uses TIA.amplify. Noise is added before gain and finite-bandwidth filtering. Density can represent the measured receiver noise budget; no implicit second thermal-noise source. No TIA saturation model.

params.name: bandwidth_enabled
params.description: Apply the established first-order backward-Euler low-pass.

params.name: bandwidth_Hz
params.description: Nominal analog −3 dB bandwidth; discrete response depends on fs. First output equals first input × gain.

params.name: noise_enabled
params.description: Global noise AND this switch enable input-referred white current noise.

params.name: noise_A_sqrtHz
params.description: User-specified total input current noise density; variance before filtering is density² fs/2.

params.name: seed
params.description: Block seed offset. Combined with run seed and instance ID; integer 0..2^32-1.
